scope: Explicit AC1021 default ACAD_MATERIAL graph; three source-witnessed nonprocedural defaults only. Existing AC1024 opt-in preserved; no other revisions admitted. No broad DWG interoperability claim.
authority: ODA v5.4.1 specifies AC1021 common object streams and LAYER/HEADER handles but does not publish a MATERIAL body schema. The body is bounded to the exact independently produced source graph; it is not generalized from this observation.

source.author: ODA File Converter, from locally authored DXF

source_bit_comparison.contents: Class and common prefix, data, strings, trailer, role-4 owner and reactor, and zero end bits all match bit for bit. The extraction uses the in-tree RS decoder and decompressor and the object comparison uses the writer constructor; it is not an independent implementation.

generated.explanation: Generated self handle is one byte wider; dictionary owner/reactor are each one byte wider. Complete raw frame comparison includes the two zero pad bits; this comparison uses the in-tree constructor.

independent_peer.outcome: LibreDWG 0.14 verifies 63 decoded non-identity fields per material, class manifest, owner/reactor, NOD, HEADER and LAYER links, and data/string boundaries. Peer trace infers but does not inspect the two pad-bit values. Thirteen synthetic fault controls and wrong source hash reject.

oda_audit.result: Both files produced only .err, no DXF. Each records 16 earlier object warnings and fatal AcDbViewportTableRecord (0x16), requiring recovery. There is no LAYER warning; this run cannot establish MATERIAL object acceptance or whole-file interoperability.

native_readback: AC1021 emits three named materials with correct owner/reactor but deliberately retains their 550-bit bodies opaque; native semantic decoding is AC1024-only and remains unchanged.
regressions: libdxfrw_dwg_default_material_optin parameterized AC1021/AC1024: graph, caller layer and current-material controls, aliases/collisions, ignored failures, sentinel preservation and same-facade retry; AC1015/1018/1027/1032 opt-in refused. libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_default_material passes. No fixtures committed.
qualification: The explicit opt-in assumes caller attestation that opaque payloads contain no hidden graph claims; caller/source layers retain their existing references and no-opt-in semantics remain unchanged.

probe_tools.reproduction: Compile each tool with c++ -std=c++17 -Isrc <tool> build-gcc/libdxfrw.a -o <executable>. Verify source and generated DWG SHA-256 above, run extractor with source or generated and the corresponding DWG and page path, verify the declared page SHA-256, then run comparator with the same source or generated mode and page path. Both modes are source-specific and require exact specified files. One-bit change at source page offset 3672 is rejected; no stored fixture is required.

validation: Before the separate VPORT edits: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_default_material_optin_tests libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_default_material_tests; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R "libdxfrw_dwg_(default_material_optin|ac1024_default_material)$" --output-on-failure: 2/2 passed. Python-only peer-audit CTest passed 13 negative controls. Separate later combined VPORT/material coherent build also passed.
isolated_validation: Clean archive of b6c87132 plus only this staged material candidate, built with AddressSanitizer, passed libdxfrw_dwg_default_material_optin and libdxfrw_ac1021_material_peer_audit 2/2. The uncommitted VPORT correction was excluded.
